## Summary

Explain what changed and why. Keep the pull request focused on one problem.

## Linked issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Build, dependency, or CI maintenance

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran:

```text
npm test
```

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots when UI output changed. Write `Not applicable` when no
visible behavior changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for changed behavior or contracts.
- [ ] No breaking changes are introduced, or they are clearly documented and approved.
- [ ] Screenshots are included if UI behavior or appearance changed.
- [ ] A related issue is linked above.
- [ ] New behavior has appropriate test coverage.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, generated projects, or unauthorized content.
- [ ] I reviewed the contribution guidelines and Code of Conduct.

## Reviewer notes

Call out security considerations, compatibility risks, migration needs, deferred work,
or areas where you want focused review.
